equal_native_effective_storage: explicit equality/alias metadata may avoid duplicate arrays; readers must preserve native/effective semantics
probability_meaning: native gate distribution at this branch's actual input, including effects from earlier modified layers
combine_weights_source: actual native and effective gate returns, never reconstructed from quantized probabilities after intervention
request_execution: serialize begin/infer/end within each model's request context; flush once per query
consumer_state: preserve monitor history, action queue, RNG and query counter across storage blocks; restore from pre-query snapshot for branches
snapshot_observations: persist exact policy inputs and observable/RNG state at alarm points
multi_detector_snapshot_policy: deduplicate equal main_id/query_id first alarms; retain method provenance and sampling probabilities
main_first_rule: finish and durably commit the untouched main rollout before scheduling interventions
reference_isolation: profiles remain checkpoint-specific and frozen; never fit or append reference points from the active evaluation rollout
